lines.en: Why did the policeman ask the writer to come to the police station?
lines.cn: 为什么警察让那位作家去警察局呢？

lines.en: It must have been about two in the morning when I returned home.
lines.cn: 我回到家时，大概已经是凌晨两点左右了。

lines.en: I tried to wake up my wife by ringing the doorbell,
lines.cn: 我试着按门铃叫醒我的妻子，

lines.en: so I got a ladder from the shed in the garden, put it against the wall,
lines.cn: 于是我从花园里的棚屋里拿了一把梯子，把它靠在墙上，

lines.en: and began climbing towards the bedroom window.
lines.cn: 然后开始往卧室的窗户爬去。

lines.en: I was almost there when a sarcastic voice below said.
lines.cn: 我快爬到窗户的时候，下面传来一个讽刺的声音：

lines.en: 'I don't think the windows need cleaning at this time of the night.'
lines.cn: ‘我觉得这个时候窗户并不需要清洁。’

lines.en: I looked down and nearly fell off the ladder when I saw a policeman.
lines.cn: 我往下看，差点从梯子上掉下来，因为看到了一个警察。

lines.en: I immediately regretted answering in the way I did, but I said, 'I enjoy cleaning windows at night.'
lines.cn: 我立刻后悔自己之前的回答方式，但还是说：‘我喜欢在晚上清洁窗户。’

lines.en: 'So do I,' answered the policeman in the same tone.
lines.cn: ‘我也是，’警察用同样的语气回答道。

lines.en: I hate to interrupt a man when he's busy working, but would you mind coming with me to the station?'
lines.cn: “我很不想在一个人忙于工作的时候打扰他，但你能陪我去车站吗？”

lines.en: 'Well, I'd prefer to stay here,' I said.
Fortunately, the shouting woke up my wife who opened the window just as the policeman had started to climb towards me.
lines.cn: 幸运的是，我的喊声吵醒了我的妻子，就在警察开始朝我走来的时候，她打开了窗户。
